title: What applies gets its labelled summary, and J-11 runs end to end
goal: The model drafts a labelled summary above the untouched list, and J-11, ACC-S1 and ACC-S6 journeys pass.
acceptance: AiPurpose what_applies; summary through the wrapper labelled AI-drafted with the fixed sentence, citations as stable keys, model and version logged; prompt holds the description (like Ask's question) and in-scope library facts only, never register content and never a bank's own record; fallbacks model_failed, timeout, ai_off, budget_cap keep the list; cost counted against the monthly cap; WHAT_APPLIES_SUMMARY_DEADLINE_MS (2000); ACC-S5 and ACC-S8 un-skipped; ACC-S1, ACC-S6 and ACC-S13 (J-11 @smoke through the UI and the real API with the issued key; card obligation 404, write 403 read_only_credential, revoke then 401; teardown on failure) un-fixmed; ACC-06 and ACC-09 cells.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, D-07, ADR 0057 and CLAUDE.md section 11 in full.

title: The six MCP tools, the same gates and bodies as REST
goal: tools/call serves search, list_obligations, get_obligation, list_upcoming_changes, list_register_entries and what_applies.
acceptance: Each tool calls the REST route's gate and logic with its pagination; problem codes map to tool errors keeping the code; parity test REST body equals structured content; a mutating route answers 403 read_only_credential over both; the access log records the tool name; ACC-S7 un-skipped; ACC-05 cell.

title: The personal tokens screen, the credential list, and the token and reach journeys
goal: Members mint and revoke tokens, admins see every credential, and ACC-S3 and ACC-S11 run end to end.
acceptance: Mint with scopes, optional entry and bounded expiry behind step-up, shown once, list, revoke, restricted without tokens.create; API keys lists every key and token with kind and entry or person and revokes each; ACC-S3 and ACC-S11 (self-approval refused, second person approves with passkey, switch off makes register calls 403 tenant_reach_off) un-fixmed.

title: Who a stricter passkey policy would refuse (ADR 0048 tranche 3)
goal: Admins see members without a compliant passkey before saving a stricter policy, and members see their own.
acceptance: meetsPolicy on passkey reads; a members filter 'without a compliant passkey'; shown on admin members and my passkeys; a shell notice before the notice date; ID-07 built (or in_progress naming c11-device-allowlist if the list is still absent).
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, ADR 0048. Default keeps this in R2 so ID-07 can close built.

title: J-8 covers R2: comments, notifications, participants and configuration
goal: TEN-S7 proves tenant B sees nothing of A's R2 records or configuration.
acceptance: TEN-S7 @smoke extended: B sees none of A's comments on the shared change's case and obligation, GET /comments on A's case 404 declared, B's inbox holds nothing of A's, only B's participants show, and by URL B gets not-found (never 403) for A's entities, departments, teams, products, support grants, tenant agents and settings, agent access entries and credentials and security policy; B's lists show only B's rows; one A-only row of each seeded (A_ONLY constants); TEN-S7's Gherkin matches step for step.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md and CLAUDE.md section 11 in full.

title: The bank's own records applied and approved inside the bank
goal: Owned proposals apply into owned records and are approved in the bank's own queue; the register accepts them.
acceptance: Owned kinds apply with owner_tenant from the proposal inside the proposal door; owned-target lookups in reading.py; a provision under a private instrument 422 private_provisions_not_supported; shared-to-owned and back refused; machine-proposed provenance naming the agent, verified by the approving person; list/approve/reject under private_records.approve with step-up, proposer 409 through the unchanged four-eyes CHECK, reject needs a reason, audit and outbox in the tenant zone with the assertion and no note text; console or support session 404; register sets applicability and status on an owned obligation, B 404, agent access never sees it; PRO-S12, PRO-S15, INV-S9 (support-grant line), INV-S15, REG-S17 un-skipped; the fence allowlist unchanged; INV-07 cell.
brief: Built under D-89. Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, D-57, ADR 0050, ADR 0059. You own proposals/logic.py this wave to let approve and reject serve a bank's own proposal for a person holding private_records.approve in that bank; the shared queue's rules do not change.

title: A bank's agent researches an approved scope item and files the bank's own proposals
goal: An approved scope item opens a research request for the bank's scope-researcher, and its findings arrive as owned proposals through runner events only.
acceptance: On scope_item.added (an outbox handler in agents/apps.py) a research request of kind scope_item opens for the bank's scope-researcher ('waiting for your agent' otherwise), keys and ids only; honours cap and AI off; runner events file owned proposals through proposals/tenant_agent.py with owner_tenant forced to the run's bank; shared targets, non-private kinds and re-tags refused; text screened (AGT-07); idempotent per run and event; a duplicate by official reference or stable key 409 already_in_our_library by a database lookup, never by giving the model the bank's records; each proposal names the agent, its version and the reported model and reads 'Proposed by our agent'; a test proves a bank key still opens no run and files nothing (refuse_tenant_key and key scopes unchanged); a guard proves no run writes a scope item, footprint term or scope request; AGT-S14 and AGT-S16 un-skipped; security review.
brief: Built under D-89; free-text fields wait for Alex's tenant-text answer. Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, D-32, D-57, D-89, ADR 0059 and SCOPE_ITEMS.md. The channel is ADR 0059's; do not add an API-key path.

title: The scope-item panel on the regulatory scope page
goal: Admins propose and approve scope items and see research status.
acceptance: Propose an add or remove with its fields; items in the pending request and preview; approve with step-up; four-eyes refusal from its code; research status per item; unit tests; FP journeys unaffected.

title: Security review of chunk 8, with fixes
goal: Chunk 8's diff is reviewed with the guard suites and every medium-or-higher finding is fixed test-first.
acceptance: Guard suites (rls, tenant isolation, library fence, route permissions, audit on write, four eyes) green; report written; critical, high and medium fixed test-first with the review rerun clean; lower findings as HARDENING rows; a fix touching an invariant stops and goes to Alex.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md and R1's docs/reviews/CHUNK7_REVIEW_2026-09-23.md for shape. Check tenancy and composite keys; support access adds no tenant-table policy beyond ADR 0042's one, keeps its allow-list and logs each read; four eyes on risk acceptance and support grants and none on applicability (D-75); recurring_duty's fence; soft removal of links and units; no interpretation, note, gap text or comment in an audit after value, log, outbox or model input; paste, bulk, RRULE and key validation; My work and SoA permission filtering. Do not edit files a wave-6 build package owns; record such fixes as HARDENING rows for the integrator.

title: Security review of chunk 9, with fixes
goal: The case workflow's diff is reviewed and medium-or-higher findings fixed.
acceptance: Six guard suites green; findings fixed test-first until nothing medium or above; lower ones as HARDENING rows with a package named.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md. Evidence: any download before a clean scan, server-measured hash and size, no filename in logs, storage key, infected bytes. Four eyes and step-up: every path by which a requester could sign off; the one-person close paths (a contributor cannot close through applies = no; a signed-off close cannot reopen); no third door into closed. Actions and evidence removed softly only. Tenancy on every route, library fence across sign-off, permissions, one audit per write and download, transitions only in state.py. Do not edit files a wave-6 build package owns.

title: Security review of chunk 10, with fixes
goal: Collaboration's diff is reviewed and medium-or-higher findings fixed.
acceptance: A planted string reaches no sink (log, Sentry, audit, outbox, notification title, mail, URL); one recipient check; the delegation hop cannot loop or grant; forced RLS and the append-only trigger on the five tables; per-tenant fan-out; route gates and UNGATED entries; workflow route permission; library fence (tag filter, outbox producers); mail hosts; fixes test-first; lower findings as HARDENING rows.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md. Do not edit files a wave-6 build package owns.
